visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up of a brown tabby cat sleeping deeply on a cream-colored bed. A human hand holding a white and orange treat stick enters the frame and moves the stick near the cat's nose. The cat twitches its nose, wakes up, and begins licking the treat enthusiastically. (2) A tortoiseshell cat is shown sleeping in a brightly lit room. The hand approaches again with the treat stick. The cat immediately wakes up upon smelling it and starts eating. (3) A white cat with grey spots is curled up under a blue and grey patterned blanket. As the treat stick is brought close, the cat's eyes snap open and it begins to lick the product. (4) A black and white cat resting on a white windowsill wakes up and licks the treat stick being held by a hand. (5) An orange cat sleeping on a brown burlap-textured mat wakes up and licks the treat stick. (6) A tortoiseshell cat is sleeping inside a cardboard box. It wakes and licks the treat, with its tongue visible. (7) A woman with dark hair and glasses wearing a white shirt is shown in a studio-like setting holding a cat and the product. Three boxes of cat treats are displayed behind her on a shelf. (8) A series of quick cuts show various cats from earlier scenes continuing to eat the treats, with text overlays appearing on screen. (9) The video ends with a solid pink screen featuring the white logo '好味小姐 LADY FLAVOR'.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced, upbeat electronic music begins with a consistent 120 BPM tempo. Frequent 'pop' and 'ding' sound effects trigger every second or two, synchronized with visual cuts and the appearance of the treat stick. (2) The music continues as a steady background layer. No vocals are present initially. Each new cat shown eating is accompanied by a rhythmic impact sound effect. (3) A female voice enters at approximately 00:43, speaking in an excited and friendly professional narrative tone. The speech rate is fast and energetic, matching the musical tempo. (4) The BGM swells slightly as the voice finishes its announcement, leading into a final logo animation accompanied by a short melodic jingle.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To demonstrate the irresistible scent and taste of Lady Flavor cat treats by showing multiple cats waking up immediately to eat them, followed by an official product launch announcement.
